[L]'s route for Lemma 14.28 (Grill.Coarse/Credit) takes the bounded coarse estimate as a hypothesis ('its production is an outstanding physical/RG question'), so the display is not inlined anywhere; the claim stands, and the numerics are consistent, so no typo.
